prompt_translation: Separate pale garments from the white background through subtle tonal and material differences, never through a dark outline.
Make silk, gauze, brocade, embroidery and metal respond differently to the same studio light instead of sharing one fantasy gloss.
Use believable gravity and slightly irregular ground folds; avoid perfectly mirrored sleeves, hems and sheer edges.
fabric_white.principle: White-on-white asset photography must separate garment from background through material response, tonal spacing, edge transmission and contact shadow rather than artificial outlines.

round_plan.prompt_strategy: refine white-on-white separation, material-specific response and natural drape only; lock identity, P9 and costume architecture
